name: Return of the Three Moons
title: Return of the Three Moons
desc:
"I turn my body into moonlight, and pour it over Nod-Krai..."
"My soul, I leave here... To inform my future friends..."
"Lastly... I will hide the Trilune authority within the Frost Moon..."
"And when my body, soul, and authority are reunited..."
"Finally..."

skills.desc:
Discard the 3 cards with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost in your Hand.
At the start of your next Round, heal all your characters on the field for 3.
At the start of the Round after that, add the 3 Discarded cards to your Hand and give each of them 3 stacks of Cost Reduction.
(Only one "Arcane Legend" card can be played per match. This card will be in your starting hand.)
